For the returning veterans of the game, you just pissed all of them off by delisting the original and all DLC content. The relaunch of the game is pretty much the original with all the extra content and a fresh set of graphical paint. Did you know these mods were originally created by the community? Did that stop them from taking it anyway and monetizing it with no changes, bugfixes or anything to justify doing that?

Then you expect the same community, after pretty much spitting in their face, to pay money for no new content (that you also pretty much stole) for the exact same product? This is also glossing over that some of the DLCs players deliberately avoided grabbing for being clunky and generally recieved poorly - some users just don't want that being added as part of the main game content. 

If this is a marketing strategy, you would earn more money from us by being honest and genuine while communicating with your audience more. There is no shame in admitting you need money, don't do this 'behind our backs' act. 

This game is fun but the developers need to be significantly more transparent.
